description: This PHP class defines a console command for deleting a database savepoint within the OrangeHRM testing framework. It extends the base Command class and interacts with the DatabaseBackupService to perform the deletion, providing user feedback via console output.

classes.name: DeleteDatabaseSavepointCommand
classes.description: A console command class that facilitates deletion of a specified database savepoint during testing.

methods.name: getCommandName
methods.description: Returns the name of the console command to be invoked.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Sets up the command description and required arguments for the console command.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes the command to delete a specified savepoint and provides feedback on success or failure.
